[IRET.19.4] The engine must tick exactly once per `ds_engine_pump`, before
the pump's firing loop ([IRET.11.4]), and must not tick between two firings of
one pump. The tick is the TTL sweep ([IRET.19.3]) and the `$ClockTick`
turnover ([IRET.19.5]). `ds_rete_run` does not tick: a caller that runs the
firing loop outside the pump gets no tick.
